items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: he would come and get me in the afternoon, in the morning sometime, and take me home. With that old mom in car.

ctx.x: Yeah. He's still around. He's going to be coaching. Yes, indeed. I'm 62 years old. Remarkable, yeah. Can't believe him.

He's great. I guess, uh, John Earl used to follow all the sports, uh, and boxers and people tell that he knew- He used to play pool, they say. Did he ever mention, talk or anything about playing pool with you or-

No. He was sick when I first went there, you know. And he was so far behind when he's worked, that he would come and get me in the afternoon, in the morning sometime, and take me home. With that old mom in car. But he did write his music there, then you know.
